Joint residual-proxy bootstrap for proxy SVARs

Source: R/id-extra.R
proxy_draws.Rd

Draws nboot bootstrap samples of \((B,\Sigma,\gamma)\): "wild" multiplies \((\hat u_t, z_t)\) by a common Rademacher weight (Mertens-Ravn style; NOT recommended, since \(w_t^2=1\) leaves \(T^{-1}\sum u_t z_t\) unchanged, so \(\gamma\) only varies through re-estimated VAR coefficients and bands are far too narrow, as shown by Jentsch & Lunsford 2019 and in validation/ident-extra.R); "mbb" (default) resamples moving blocks of the pairs \((\hat u_t, z_t)\) (block length block, default the Jentsch-Lunsford rule \(\mathrm{round}(5.03\,T^{1/4})\)), preserving serial dependence in both (Jentsch & Lunsford 2019). Each draw re-estimates the VAR on the bootstrap data and recomputes \(\gamma^* = T^{-1}\sum u^*_t z^*_t\). Percentile bands of the normalised IRF are only reliable with a strong instrument.

Usage

proxy_draws(
  fit,
  z,
  nboot = 1000L,
  type = c("mbb", "wild"),
  block = NULL,
  target = 1L,
  size = 1,
  shock = target
)

Arguments

fit

a varm() fit (used to compute the point gamma).

z

proxy: numeric vector of length nrow(fit$Y) (aligned with the data; first p values dropped).

nboot

number of draws.

type

"mbb" (default, valid) or "wild" (invalid for gamma uncertainty, kept for comparison).

block

block length for "mbb".

target

<tidy-select> variable whose impact response is normalised (name or position).

size

impact response of target to the shock (e.g. 0.25 for a 25bp surprise).

shock

<tidy-select> column of the IRF array that holds the proxy shock (default target).

Value

a list with draws (a draws object, plus gamma), id (an id_proxy() carrying one gamma per draw) and fstat. Use irf(res$draws, res$id).

See also

Other identification: id_hetero(), id_proxy(), id_restrictions(), id_zerosign(), identification, irf_fry_pagan()

Examples

fit <- varm(yraw, p = 2)
z <- c(rep(0, 2), resid(fit)[, "rate"] + rnorm(nrow(resid(fit))))
pd <- proxy_draws(fit, z, nboot = 20, target = rate)
irf(pd$draws, pd$id, horizon = 4)
#> <varm IRF> K = 3, horizon 0..4, id = proxy, bands: 68%/90%
